# Blue Star Cleaning | Danyang Blue Star Anti-corrosion Cleaning Co., Ltd.

> China Industrial Cleaning Association member. 25+ years specializing in industrial equipment chemical cleaning and high-pressure water jetting services. 500+ enterprise clients, 1000+ completed projects. Based in Danyang, Jiangsu Province, China. Serving the Yangtze River Delta (Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shanghai, Anhui).

## English Pages

- [Home](https://www.lanxingqingxi.com/en/index.html): Company overview with all services, project gallery, client cases, contact info. Covers heat exchanger, pipeline, boiler, central AC, reactor, condenser, evaporative condenser, duct cleaning.
- [About](https://www.lanxingqingxi.com/en/about.html): Founded 2001. China Industrial Cleaning Association member. Integrated equipment cleaning, anti-corrosion, technical consulting and product R&D. Coverage: Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Shandong, Shanghai.
- [Services](https://www.lanxingqingxi.com/en/services.html): Full service catalog — heat exchanger cleaning, pipeline cleaning, central AC cleaning, boiler cleaning, gas primary cooler cleaning, reactor cleaning, power plant condenser cleaning, chemical cleaning, HP water jetting, thermal oil system cleaning, cooling water treatment, anti-corrosion.
- [Technology](https://www.lanxingqingxi.com/en/tech.html): 10 core technologies — online chemical cleaning, circulating cooling water online cleaning, central AC water treatment, LiBr chiller maintenance, thermal oil decoking, HP water jetting (500-2800 bar), gas primary cooler cleaning, LiBr solution regeneration, LiBr cavity cleaning, evaporative condenser descaling.
- [Cases](https://www.lanxingqingxi.com/en/cases.html): Client success stories serving Everbright Environmental, COFCO Biotechnology, Doosan Electronics, Xin'an Group, Jiangsu Sopo, China Resources Double-Crane, Zhejiang Petrochemical, and more.
- [Certifications](https://www.lanxingqingxi.com/en/certificates.html): China Industrial Cleaning Association member. Chemical cleaning standards, HP water jetting standards, safety production permit, ISO management certifications.

## Core Technologies

1. Online Chemical Cleaning at Ambient Temperature & Pressure — non-shutdown cleaning
2. Circulating Cooling Water Non-shutdown Cleaning — in-service cleaning + pre-filming
3. Central AC Water Quality Stabilization — chilled/cooling water treatment
4. LiBr Absorption Refrigeration Unit Maintenance — professional maintenance
5. Organic Heat Carrier Furnace Decoking — thermal oil system carbon removal
6. High-Pressure Water Jetting — 500-2800 bar, eco-friendly
7. Gas Primary Cooler Cleaning — coking plant specialized
8. LiBr Solution Regeneration — performance restoration
9. LiBr Unit Internal Cavity Cleaning — corrosion product removal
10. Evaporative Condenser Descaling — chemical softening + HP water
